title: Scenario runner README: how to run the cards in a Claude Code cloud session (objectstack only, subscription login, not Auto mode, one card per 2-hour command)
body:

Filing-gate category: ② maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, verbatim (Claude Code session, 2026-11-07), after asking 「你的画廊测试我可以用 workbuddy 或者 codex 测试吗？有没有入口？」, 「你现在本地测试画廊，用的什么模型」 and 「我用 Claude code 云任务可以测试画廊吗？」, then answering the seat's proposals: 「前面的建议都同意，立卡」. Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#3600. Live runs are paused by the maintainer (cloud#3600, 2026-11-07), so verify with the recorded driver and unit tests; no live run is owed.

## Ask

Add a short section to `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, "Running the cards in a Claude Code cloud session". Everything below was measured by the epic seat's runs:

- **Repository:** only objectstack-ai/objectstack is needed. The runner and the cards live here; generated apps install from npm. objectstack-ai/cloud is not needed.
- **Login:** the container's `claude` CLI is logged in with the subscription (`claude auth status`: `oauth_token`). The runner refuses an API-key login. Unset `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`.
- **Permission mode:** not Auto. Auto mode's classifier refuses launching the headless agent the runner spawns. Use Accept edits and approve the command.
- **Time:** a background command is capped at 2 hours. Run one `starter` card per command (about 20–30 min build plus the Run halves), or two commands in parallel. Do not chain several mid-tier cards in one command.
- **Build first:** `pnpm install`, then `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`. Without it, a fresh checkout fails on `Failed to resolve entry for package @objectstack/types`.
- **Network:** npm must be reachable (the default).
- **Cost:** the session's subscription quota.

Docs only; no code.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`.
